claims.text: Misoprostol has been shown to produce uterine contractions.
claims.quote: Cytotec has been shown to produce uterine contractions that may endanger pregnancy.

claims.text: Boxed warning: uterine rupture has been reported when misoprostol was given to pregnant women to induce labor or abortion;
claims.quote: UTERINE RUPTURE HAS BEEN REPORTED WHEN CYTOTEC WAS ADMINISTERED IN PREGNANT WOMEN TO INDUCE LABOR OR TO INDUCE ABORTION.

claims.text: the risk rises with advancing gestational age and with prior uterine surgery, including cesarean delivery.
claims.quote: THE RISK OF UTERINE RUPTURE INCREASES WITH ADVANCING GESTATIONAL AGES AND WITH PRIOR UTERINE SURGERY, INCLUDING CESAREAN DELIVERY
